tasks.label: mirror wikimedia images
tasks.detail: 扫描 source/ 下的 md/html，把 upload.wikimedia.org 图片下载到 source/img/wikimedia/ 并改写 URL 为 /img/wikimedia/。幂等，可重复运行以补齐网络失败项。

tasks.label: verify image links
tasks.detail: 校验 source/ 下所有 /img/... 引用是否都能对应到真实文件。

tasks.label: final-verify-120cell
tasks.command: echo --- final verify --- & node tools\verify-images.mjs & echo --- diff of polyhedral4ds --- & git --no-pager diff -- source/_posts/polyhedral4ds.md & echo --- new file --- & dir source\img\120CellPt8.jpg

tasks.label: verify-en
tasks.command: cd /d d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly-en.github.io & echo --- remaining external refs --- & findstr /s /m /c:"upload.wikimedia.org" source\*.md source\*.html & findstr /s /m /c:"software3d.com" source\*.md source\*.html & echo (above should only be alt/title text) & echo --- copied images --- & dir /b source\img\wikimedia | find /c /v "" & echo --- git status --- & git status --short

tasks.label: verify-en-refs
tasks.command: cd /d d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly-en.github.io & echo --- polyhedral4ds remaining matches --- & findstr /n /c:"software3d.com" source\_posts\polyhedral4ds.md & echo --- full verify on EN --- & node ..\wxyhly.github.io\tools\verify-images.mjs d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly-en.github.io

tasks.label: investigate-4dcity
tasks.command: echo --- EN ref --- & findstr /n /c:"4dcity001" d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly-en.github.io\source\_posts\lavie4ds.md & echo --- CN ref --- & findstr /n /c:"4dcity001" d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly.github.io\source\_posts\lavie4ds.md & echo --- EN file exists? --- & dir d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly-en.github.io\source\img\4dcity001.jpg & echo --- CN file --- & dir d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly.github.io\source\img\4dcity001.jpg

tasks.label: fix-4dcity
tasks.command: copy /Y d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly.github.io\source\img\4dcity001.jpg d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly-en.github.io\source\img\4dcity001.jpg & echo --- re-verify EN --- & node tools\verify-images.mjs d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly-en.github.io

tasks.label: en-diff
tasks.command: echo --- sample diff (EN knot4d) --- & cd /d d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly-en.github.io & git --no-pager diff --numstat -- source/ & echo --- EN polyhedral4ds head --- & git --no-pager diff -- source/_posts/polyhedral4ds.md | findstr /c:"index_img" /c:"120CellPt8"

tasks.label: en-hexo-build
tasks.command: cd /d d:\Toccbai\html5mijr\wxyhly-en.github.io & node_modules\.bin\hexo.cmd generate 2>&1 | findstr /i "ERROR FATAL" & echo EXITCODE=%ERRORLEVEL% & if exist public\img\wikimedia (echo WM_PUBLISHED=yes) else (echo WM_PUBLISHED=no) & if exist public\img\120CellPt8.jpg (echo 120CELL_PUBLISHED=yes) else (echo 120CELL_PUBLISHED=no) & if exist public\img\4dcity001.jpg (echo 4DCITY_PUBLISHED=yes) else (echo 4DCITY_PUBLISHED=no)
